_source: Curriculum Development Centre Teaching Module — "Art and Design Module" (https://library.cdcrepository.info/resource.php?id=260). Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses. CORRECTION (2026-08-28): originally mislabeled as "Term 2" — the module's own text never states its term, so the batch extraction script's default assumption went unchecked. Cross-checked directly against the CDC library's own term filter (library.cdcrepository.info, browse by term), which confirms resource id=260 is filed under Term 3. Relabeled accordingly; no content was changed, only the term/sequence fields. Other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: The module content starts at topic 1.11, indicating that earlier topics (1.1 through 1.10) are missing from the provided text, with the exception of an appended sample lesson plan referencing topic 1.9. Sub-topic 1.14.1 (Entrepreneurship in Art) did not contain an explicitly labeled 'Specific Competence' heading like the other sub-topics, so its competencies array was left empty. General competences listed at the topic level were omitted from the sub-topic competency arrays to adhere strictly to stated sub-topic competencies.

subject.name: Art and Design
subject.description: Art and Design syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 1.11 CRAFTS IN 2D
topics.description: This topic focuses on the exploration and creation of two-dimensional art forms, emphasizing the development of essential skills such as analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration. Learners experiment with different materials and methods to express ideas visually while enhancing their understanding of artistic concepts.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.1 PICTURE MAKING
sub_topics.description: Explores various two-dimensional composition methods such as collage, montage, mosaic, and frieze, enabling learners to express thoughts and emotions through visual storytelling.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.2 WEAVING
sub_topics.description: Exposes learners to the definition, materials, and techniques of weaving, involving the interlacing of threads or flexible materials to create textiles and decorative items.

topics.name: 1.12 CRAFTS IN 3D
topics.description: This topic covers the creation of three-dimensional objects using various materials and techniques. It allows learners to express creativity and imagination by producing both traditional and modern crafts.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.1 BOOK CRAFT
sub_topics.description: Provides skills and knowledge to design and create handmade books using techniques such as bookbinding, design, and craftsmanship.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.2 PAPIER-MÂCHÉ CRAFT
sub_topics.description: Explores the traditional art of creating objects by layering paper strips or pulp with adhesive materials onto bases or molds.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.3 GENERAL CRAFTS
sub_topics.description: Covers a broad range of hand-made craft activities using found materials such as paper, fabric, and wood to develop cutting, shaping, and assembling skills.

competencies.description: Make various items using found materials

topics.name: 1.13 SCULPTURE
topics.description: Focuses on the art of making solid, three-dimensional figures viewable from all sides ('in the round'). It introduces learners to freestanding and relief forms ranging from small figurines to life-size statues.

sub_topics.name: 1.13.1 INTRODUCTION TO SCULPTURE
sub_topics.description: Introduces fundamental concepts, types, and approaches in sculpture making, encouraging experimentation with local materials.

competencies.description: Experimenting with basic approaches in sculpture making

sub_topics.name: 1.13.2 CONSTRUCTION AND ASSEMBLAGE
sub_topics.description: Focuses on creating three-dimensional artworks by combining, joining, and assembling various recyclable and found materials.

sub_topics.name: 1.13.3 CARVING
sub_topics.description: Exposes learners to subtractive sculptural techniques involving cutting or chipping away parts of materials like wood, stone, or soap to create forms.

topics.name: 1.14 ENTREPRENEURSHIP
topics.description: Explores the intersection of art and business, teaching learners how to leverage their artistic skills and creativity to launch viable business ventures.

sub_topics.name: 1.14.1 ENTREPRENEURSHIP IN ART
sub_topics.description: Guides learners on turning artistic passion into sustainable business enterprises such as art studios, custom painting, craft production, digital services, and exhibitions.
